module.purpose: Provides Vue components and composables for rendering the current router match, handling route errors, conditionally rendering matched content, and selecting current, parent, or child matches.
module.summary: This module is the Vue rendering bridge for TanStack Router matches. It builds the root match renderer with SSR-aware suspense behavior, wraps route content in a global error boundary, exposes reactive route matching, and provides match-selection composables. It also augments route match metadata for Vue head elements and defines strongly typed component options for route matching.
module.businessContext: Supports navigation and route rendering in Vue applications using TanStack Router. Failures affect displayed pages, pending states, route error recovery, and components that depend on current match data.

detail.name: useMatches
detail.signature: export function useMatches<TRouter extends AnyRouter = RegisteredRouter, TSelected = unknown>(opts?: UseMatchesBaseOptions<TRouter, TSelected>): Vue.Ref<UseMatchesResult<TRouter, TSelected>>
preconditions: A router must be available through the current Vue router context.
If provided, opts.select must accept the router's route-match array and return the selected value.
postconditions: Returns a Vue.Ref whose value is derived from the router's matches store.
Without opts.select, the reference value is the current array of route matches.
With opts.select, the reference value is the result of applying opts.select to the current route-match array.
invariants: The returned reference remains connected to the router matches store and reflects store updates.
The route-match input passed to the selector is typed as an array of MakeRouteMatchUnion<TRouter>.
edgeCases: When opts is omitted, the complete reactive matches value is returned.
When opts is present without a select function, the complete reactive matches value is returned.
When opts.select is present, its returned value is exposed as the reactive reference value.
detail.summary: Provides a reactive reference to the router's current route matches. When a selector is supplied, the reference exposes the selector's result instead of the complete match list.

specTests.then: It returns a Vue.Ref whose value is the current route-match array.
It returns a Vue.Ref whose value is the result of applying select to the current route-match array.

detail.name: useParentMatches
detail.signature: export function useParentMatches<TRouter extends AnyRouter = RegisteredRouter, TSelected = unknown>(opts?: UseMatchesBaseOptions<TRouter, TSelected>): Vue.Ref<UseMatchesResult<TRouter, TSelected>>
postconditions: The matches supplied to the result selector are a shallow-copied prefix of the full matches array, ending immediately before the first match whose routeId equals the injected route context ID.
When opts.select is provided, the returned match result is the value produced by opts.select for that prefix.
When opts.select is absent, the returned match result is the parent-match prefix itself.
invariants: The full matches array is not mutated; slicing produces a new array.
Only matches before the first matching context route ID are included.
edgeCases: If the context route ID is the first match, the selected match array is empty.
If the context route ID is not found, findIndex returns -1 and the slice excludes the final match.
If multiple matches have the context route ID, only matches before the first occurrence are included.
If opts is absent or opts.select is absent, the prefix array is returned without an additional selection transformation.
detail.summary: Returns the route matches occurring before the route identified by the current route context. If a selector is provided, it is applied to that parent-match prefix before the result is returned.

specTests.when: useParentMatches() is evaluated without a selector.
specTests.then: The resulting match value contains [{ routeId: "root" }, { routeId: "parent" }].

specTests.when: useParentMatches() is evaluated without a selector.
specTests.then: The resulting match value contains only [{ routeId: "root" }], because the unmatched context causes slice(0, -1).

preconditions: The function may be called within a Vue injection context; the injected route context may be absent.
postconditions: The returned Vue.Ref is produced by useMatches.
The match list passed to the optional selector contains only entries after the injected context route, or all entries when that context route is absent or not found.
When no selector is provided, the child-match list is returned unchanged apart from slicing.
invariants: The relative order of retained matches is preserved.
The injected context match itself is excluded when it is found.
The original matches array is not modified; a sliced array is used.
edgeCases: When the injected route context is the last match, the selector receives an empty array.
When the injected route context is absent or does not occur in the matches, the selector receives all matches because slicing starts at index zero.
When opts is omitted or opts.select is absent, the sliced child-match array is returned.
When opts.select is present, its return value becomes the selected match result.
detail.summary: Returns a reactive match result containing the matches occurring after the currently injected route context. If a selector is provided, it is applied to that child-match list before the result is returned.
